senses.gloss: com. (אמץ) a thick piece of meat, a piece which can be eaten raw after pressing &c.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 128a:19">Sabb. 128ᵃ</cite> <he>חזי לא׳</he> fit to be eaten raw.
<cite ref="Chullin 44b:9">Ḥull. 44ᵇ</cite> <he>א׳ מעלייתא</he> a fine piece &c.; a. fr.—Pl. <he>אוּמְצֵי</he>.
